states.message: Welcome to Customer handling! Please select a topic you would like to learn about.
Greet every customer warmly, ask what brought them in today, and confirm whether they're a new applicant, renewing, or closing a loan before routing them further.
Listen fully before responding, acknowledge the concern, and explain the policy calmly. Escalate to the branch manager if a customer remains unsatisfied after your explanation.
Only mention other products (insurance, other loan schemes) after the customer's primary need is resolved — never during a complaint or a time-sensitive transaction.
Never discuss a customer's loan details, gold value, or personal documents within earshot of other customers. Keep screens and paperwork angled away from the counter.
